reason: A dsh web GUI desktop-pet plugin focused on interactive animated presentation, customizable appearance, and configurable behavior during idle and AI work states.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web GUI 提供可互动的鲸鱼娘桌宠，支持多套服饰、随机休闲动作、工作节奏动画和可配置行为。
summaries.en: An interactive whale-girl desktop pet for the dsh web GUI with multiple outfits, randomized idle actions, work-state animations, and configurable behavior.

capabilities: Displays an animated interactive desktop pet in the dsh web interface
Provides configurable outfits, idle actions, work-state animations, and completion celebrations
Handles plugin events and session state to update the pet’s behavior
Offers settings for animation timing, enabled actions, size, opacity, walking, and sleep behavior
